Campbell & Company Investment Adviser Holding in Marriott Vacations Wrldwde C (VAC) Has Raised as Market Value Declined; China Mobile Limited (CHL) Shareholder Intrust Bank Na Trimmed Position by $834,900 as Stock Declined 
April 23, 2018 - By Migdalia James 
Campbell & Company Investment Adviser Llc increased its stake in Marriott Vacations Wrldwde C (VAC) by 366.69% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Campbell & Company Investment Adviser Llc bought 9,666 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.00% with the market. The hedge fund held 12,302 shares of the real estate company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.66M, up from 2,636 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Campbell & Company Investment Adviser Llc who had been investing in Marriott Vacations Wrldwde C for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $3.61B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.59% or $0.81 during the last trading session, reaching $135.98. About 104,927 shares traded. Marriott Vacations Worldwide Corporation (NYSE:VAC) has risen 39.79% since April 23, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 28.24% the S&P500. 
Intrust Bank Na decreased its stake in China Mobile Limited (CHL) by 73.39% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Intrust Bank Na sold 16,698 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.06% with the market. The institutional investor held 6,054 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $306,000, down from 22,752 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Intrust Bank Na who had been investing in China Mobile Limited for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $190.35B market cap company. The stock increased 0.19% or $0.09 during the last trading session, reaching $46.52. About 345,543 shares traded. China Mobile Limited (NYSE:CHL) has declined 14.69% since April 23, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 26.24% the S&P500. 
Intrust Bank Na, which manages about $335.67M US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Ishares Tr (EFA) by 49,911 shares to 52,911 shares, valued at $3.72M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Spdr S&P 500 Etf Tr (SPY) by 5,536 shares in the quarter, for a total of 17,453 shares, and has risen its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL). 
Among 7 analysts covering China Mobile ( NYSE:CHL ), 3 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 4 Hold. Therefore 43% are positive. China Mobile had 9 analyst reports since August 21, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The company was upgraded on Tuesday, January 19 by Deutsche Bank. On Wednesday, August 10 the stock rating was maintained by Goldman Sachs with “Buy”. The stock of China Mobile Limited (NYSE:CHL) earned “Buy” rating by Jefferies on Friday, August 21. Bernstein downgraded China Mobile Limited (NYSE:CHL) on Thursday, October 27 to “Mkt Perform” rating. The firm has “Neutral” rating given on Monday, March 12 by Nomura. On Friday, March 23 the stock rating was upgraded by Jefferies to “Hold”. HSBC downgraded the stock to “Hold” rating in Friday, March 24 report. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Wednesday, August 30 by Bank of America. 
Since January 29, 2018, it had 0 insider purchases, and 3 insider sales for $748,369 activity. 2,636 shares were sold by Yonker Michael E., worth $377,502. 
Among 10 analysts covering Marriot Vacations Worldwide ( NYSE:VAC ), 6 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 4 Hold. Therefore 60% are positive. Marriot Vacations Worldwide had 27 analyst reports since July 24, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. On Monday, June 19 the stock rating was initiated by Buckingham Research with “Buy”. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Thursday, February 1 by Stifel Nicolaus. The stock of Marriott Vacations Worldwide Corporation (NYSE:VAC) earned “Buy” rating by M Partners on Friday, July 24. The firm has “An Outperform” rating given on Friday, February 5 by Credit Suisse. The company was maintained on Monday, January 11 by Stifel Nicolaus. The stock of Marriott Vacations Worldwide Corporation (NYSE:VAC) has “Market Perform” rating given on Friday, February 24 by Telsey Advisory Group. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Monday, September 25 by Stifel Nicolaus. Stifel Nicolaus maintained the shares of VAC in report on Thursday, November 2 with “Buy” rating. JMP Securities upgraded Marriott Vacations Worldwide Corporation (NYSE:VAC) on Tuesday, October 13 to “Market Outperform” rating. The rating was maintained by Telsey Advisory Group with “Market Perform” on Friday, May 5. 
Campbell & Company Investment Adviser Llc, which manages about $1.13B and $135.52 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Gibraltar Inds Inc (NASDAQ:ROCK) by 9,778 shares to 14,302 shares, valued at $472,000 in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Cummins Inc (NYSE:CMI) by 4,527 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 3,793 shares, and cut its stake in Landstar Sys Inc (NASDAQ:LSTR).
